description: STATEC, Luxembourg's statistics institute, publishes the 2021 population census in its LUSTAT database, a .Stat Suite platform, and lists each table on the national portal data.public.lu under a CC0 licence. The housing dataset has six tables: living quarters by canton and commune; conventional dwellings by occupancy status and type of building for each canton and commune; dwellings by type of building, period of construction and tenure; and three tables on rooms, ownership and occupants. The wider census dataset adds place of work tables and historic housing indicators from 1864 to 2021. Coverage is national: table B1707 returned 263,671 conventional dwellings, with 115 geography codes. Format and access: free, no registration; the SDMX REST API returns CSV or XML for each dataflow, and the LUSTAT viewer allows downloads. Licence: CC0 as stated on data.public.lu. Caveats: no water, sewer, heating or energy variables in the 2021 census tables; period of construction is national only in table B1706; commuting flows between communes are not among the published tables. Simulation uses: commune level dwelling stock by building type and occupancy for exposure and demand allocation, and building age for retrofit and vulnerability models. Related records: the Iceland census 2021 dwelling tables and the Lithuania census 2021 dwelling amenities API.

provider: STATEC, Institut national de la statistique et des études économiques du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg
schema_summary: Six tables: B1711 living quarters by canton and commune; B1707 conventional dwellings by occupancy status (occupied, not occupied, unknown), building type (residential with one, two or three or more dwellings, non residential) and commune; B1706 by building type, construction period (before 1919 to 2016 and later) and tenure; B1708 to B1710 by rooms, ownership and occupants. SDMX dimensions include GEO, TYPE_BUILD_DWE, OCC_STATUS_CONV, CONSTR_PERIOD_DWE, TIME_PERIOD
